description:
Venezuela. A lost world hidden deep in the jungle of South America.
A country where entire regions are still isolated, preserved in their raw, primeval state.
Ancient table mountains rise straight out of the jungle, their flat summits cut off from the world for millions of years. 
Water spills from their edges in impossible drops, vanishing into mist before it ever reaches the forest floor.
